def ccw(x): return [list(r) for r in zip(*x)][::-1]

out=[x+y for x,y in zip(a,b)]+[x+y for x,y in zip(c,d)]
assert len(out)==26 and all(len(r)==26 for r in out)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':out},separators=(',',':')))
